name: Janelle Armstrong
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Dr Janelle Armstrong is an EMDR Accredited Practitioner and Clinical and Forensic Psychologist with over 20 years’ experience providing psychological treatment to adolescents and adults. Dr Armstrong has a strong clinical focus on the treatment of trauma, including complex trauma, and works with individuals who have experienced a range of adverse life events, including victimisation, interpersonal trauma, and significant life stressors. She also supports clients presenting with emotional regulation difficulties, anxiety, and related impacts of trauma, including challenges arising during the perinatal period and early parenthood. Her approach to EMDR therapy is grounded in creating a safe, structured, and collaborative therapeutic environment where clients feel supported and understood throughout the reprocessing of distressing experiences.
